label: solitaire ring
construction: A solitaire ring: one continuous shank, a single center stone held in a setting with prongs or a bezel that visibly grips the stone, the setting joined to the shank. One stone only unless the specification says otherwise.
photo: Studio product photograph, soft even lighting, white seamless background, subtle shadow, the ring fills the frame, no text, no people, no props.
views: three-quarter view showing the stone, the setting, and the shank
top-down view of the stone and setting

checks.question: Is there exactly one center stone unless more were specified?
Is the stone visibly held by prongs or a bezel that is joined to the shank?
Is the shank a single continuous band?
